title: Version timeline: the date rail with black date chips (the current one yellow), category columns, hatched empty lanes and four event bars with kind chips
use: A version calendar or schedule strip. current picks the highlighted date chip; event bars are drawn fills (pictures can be layered by the page).

last_len.note: length of the last event in days

relations: 44 days across the lanes; date chips sit on the rail at their day; events start and end on their days.
Lanes 104 units with 82-unit bars; categories own whole lanes; empty lane ground is hatched, never blank.
decoration: Day ticks, contours inside bars, the tri-code rule, start-date tags: drawn.

provenance.corpus: traverse case (远垦导线 TRAVERSE): our own original one-page game site and two in-game screens in the frontier-survey grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/frontier-survey/style.json provenance (reference site measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: The case's calendar section (site/index.html #calendar) as a parametric strip; layout from the reference's calendar.
measured: Reference: timeline 1761 x 39 under a 1697 x 366 head; date chips about 148 x 37 with 30 px white digits; event banners in lanes with a category icon column and -45 degree hatched empty ground.
Case mobile first pass: an event's line-art object sat under its title on the narrow layout (1:1 ground); objects are dropped from event bars below 760 wide.
